instructions: Tools for reading Hacker News content: individual items (stories, comments, jobs, polls, poll options), user profiles, and curated story-id feeds (top, new, best, Ask HN, Show HN, jobs). To get full details on stories found via a feed tool, call get_item with each id. All data is read-only and public; no authentication is required.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Fetch a single Hacker News item (story, comment, job posting, poll, or poll option) by its numeric id. Use this to get full details—title, author, text, url, score, comment ids, etc.—for an id you already have (e.g. from a feed tool or from a story's 'kids'/'parts' list). Returns the item's raw fields, or a null/empty result if the id doesn't exist or was deleted.
tools.returns: Object with fields such as id, type, by, time, text, url, title, score, descendants, kids (comment ids), parts (poll option ids), parent, deleted, dead.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch a Hacker News user's public profile by exact, case-sensitive username. Use this to check a user's karma, bio, account creation date, or list of submitted item ids. Only users with public activity (at least one comment or story) exist; unknown usernames return an empty result.

args.name: username
args.description: The user's exact, case-sensitive HN username.

tools.returns: Object with id (username), created (unix timestamp), karma, about (bio HTML), and submitted (list of item ids).

tools.name: get_top_stories
tools.description: Get the current front-page 'top stories' on Hacker News (may include jobs) as a list of item ids, ordered by current rank. Use this when an agent asks what's trending or on the HN front page right now. Follow up with get_item on individual ids to get titles/urls/scores. Does not itself return story titles or content.
tools.returns: Array of up to 500 item ids, ranked from top to bottom.

tools.name: get_new_stories
tools.description: Get the most recently submitted stories on Hacker News as a list of item ids, newest first. Use this when an agent wants the latest submissions rather than ranked/popular ones. Follow up with get_item to fetch details for specific ids.
tools.returns: Array of up to 500 item ids, newest first.

tools.name: get_best_stories
tools.description: Get Hacker News' 'best stories' list (stories with the highest recent score, distinct from the live front-page ranking) as a list of item ids. Use this for a quality/popularity-ranked view rather than pure recency. Follow up with get_item for details on specific ids.
tools.returns: Array of item ids ranked by score.

tools.name: get_ask_stories
tools.description: Get the latest 'Ask HN' discussion posts as a list of item ids. Use this when an agent specifically wants Ask HN threads (text-based discussion questions posed to the community), not regular link stories. Follow up with get_item for details.
tools.returns: Array of up to 200 Ask HN item ids, most recent first.

tools.name: get_show_stories
tools.description: Get the latest 'Show HN' posts (projects/products people are showcasing) as a list of item ids. Use this when an agent wants Show HN submissions specifically. Follow up with get_item for details.
tools.returns: Array of up to 200 Show HN item ids, most recent first.

tools.name: get_job_stories
tools.description: Get the latest job postings on Hacker News as a list of item ids. Use this when an agent asks about HN job listings specifically. Follow up with get_item for details such as title and url.
tools.returns: Array of up to 200 job item ids, most recent first.
